        return b
    end
    tbtn("|<", 8, 44, C(45,40,60), function() Cut.setPlaying(false); Cut.seek(0) end)
    tbtn("<", 56, 44, C(45,40,60), function() Cut.setPlaying(false); Cut.seek(Cut.playhead - 1 / Cut.fps) end)
    Cut.playBtn = tbtn("PLAY", 104, 96, C(60,190,120), function() Cut.setPlaying(not Cut.playing) end)
    tbtn(">", 204, 44, C(45,40,60), function() Cut.setPlaying(false); Cut.seek(Cut.playhead + 1 / Cut.fps) end)
    tbtn(">|", 252, 44, C(45,40,60), function() Cut.setPlaying(false); Cut.seek(Cut.length) end)
    local loopBtn
    loopBtn = tbtn("LOOP: ALL", 300, 96, C(45,40,60), function()
        Cut.loopSlice = not Cut.loopSlice
        loopBtn.Text = Cut.loopSlice and "LOOP: SLICE" or "LOOP: ALL"
        loopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Cut.loopSlice and C(70,120,255) or C(45,40,60)
    end)

    -- ── notes ──
    local seY = trY + 40
    F.makeDivider(pg, seY, THEMES[currentThemeName].accent)
    local seTitle = F.makeLabel(pg, "NOTES", UDim2.new(0,8,0,seY+6), UDim2.new(0,120,0,18),
        C(255,80,180), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 11)
    seTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    F.regText(seTitle)
    F.makeLabel(pg, "Type an ID into a note to load it. Click a note to see its animation.",
        UDim2.new(0,8,0,seY+24), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,14), C(130,130,150), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)

    Cut.dirBtns = {}
    local rowFrames = {}
    local function selectDir(dir)
        for d, b in pairs(Cut.dirBtns) do
            b.BackgroundColor3 = (d == dir) and ARROW_COLORS[d].hit or C(35,35,55)
            b.TextColor3 = (d == dir) and C(15,15,20) or C(238,238,248)
        end
        for d, rf in pairs(rowFrames) do
            rf.BackgroundTransparency = (d == dir) and 0.1 or 0.6
        end
        if Cut.noteLbl then
            Cut.noteLbl.Text = ARROW_SYMBOLS[dir] .. " " .. dir
            Cut.noteLbl.TextColor3 = ARROW_COLORS[dir].hit
        end
        Cut.editDir(dir)
        Cut.drawSlices()
    end
    Cut.selectDir = selectDir

    for i, dir in ipairs(ARROW_ORDER) do
        local b = F.makeBtn(pg, ARROW_SYMBOLS[dir] .. " " .. dir,
            UDim2.new(0, 8 + (i-1) * 100, 0, seY + 44), UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 30), C(35,35,55), nil, 10)
        Cut.dirBtns[dir] = b
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() selectDir(dir) end)
    end

    local mY = seY + 82
    local markStart = F.makeBtn(pg, "MARK START", UDim2.new(0,8,0,mY), UDim2.new(0,126,0,28), C(60,190,120), nil, 10)
    local markStop  = F.makeBtn(pg, "MARK STOP",  UDim2.new(0,140,0,mY), UDim2.new(0,126,0,28), C(200,70,70), nil, 10)
    local playSlice = F.makeBtn(pg, "PLAY SLICE", UDim2.new(0,272,0,mY), UDim2.new(0,124,0,28), C(70,120,255), nil, 10)
    markStart.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if Cut.length <= 0 then F.notify("Load an animation first", "warn"); return end
        cutterSlices[Cut.selDir].start = Cut.playhead
        Cut.drawSlices()
    end)
    markStop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if Cut.length <= 0 then F.notify("Load an animation first", "warn"); return end
        cutterSlices[Cut.selDir].stop = Cut.playhead
        Cut.drawSlices()
    end)
    playSlice.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if Cut.length <= 0 then return end
        Cut.loopSlice = true
        loopBtn.Text = "LOOP: SLICE"; loopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C(70,120,255)
        local s = cutterSlices[Cut.selDir]
        Cut.seek(math.min(s.start, s.stop))
        Cut.setPlaying(true)
    end)

    -- one card per note: its own animation ID, then its in/out times
    local nY = mY + 38
    local CARD = 66
    Cut.startBoxes, Cut.stopBoxes, Cut.idBoxes = {}, {}, {}
    for i, dir in ipairs(ARROW_ORDER) do
        local ry = nY + (i-1) * CARD
        local d = dir

        local card = Instance.new("Frame")
        card.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,CARD - 6); card.Position = UDim2.new(0,8,0,ry)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = C(24,22,33); card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0; card.Parent = pg
        F.uiCorner(card, UDim.new(0,7))
        local cs = F.uiStroke(card, ARROW_COLORS[dir].hit, 1)
        cs.Transparency = 0.6
        rowFrames[dir] = card

        local lbl = F.makeLabel(card, ARROW_SYMBOLS[dir] .. " " .. dir, UDim2.new(0,8,0,4),
            UDim2.new(0,70,0,24), ARROW_COLORS[dir].hit, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 11)
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

        -- this note's own animation
        local idBox = F.makeBox(card, UDim2.new(0,80,0,4), UDim2.new(1,-168,0,24),
            "uses default animation", cutterSlices[dir].id or "")
        idBox.TextSize = 10
        Cut.idBoxes[dir] = idBox
        local function commitId()
            local clean = (idBox.Text:gsub("%D",""))
            local changed = clean ~= (cutterSlices[d].id or "")
            cutterSlices[d].id = clean
            idBox.Text = clean
            if clean ~= "" then F.cutterTrackFor(clean) end
            -- typing an ID loads it straight into the preview
            if changed then
                Cut.noteLbl.Text = ARROW_SYMBOLS[d] .. " " .. d
                selectDir(d)
                Cut.editDir(d, true)
            end
        end
        idBox.FocusLost:Connect(function() commitId() end)

        local view = F.makeBtn(card, "VIEW", UDim2.new(1,-82,0,4), UDim2.new(0,74,0,24),
            C(70,120,255), nil, 9)
        view.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() commitId(); selectDir(d) end)

        -- in / out
        F.makeLabel(card, "IN", UDim2.new(0,8,0,32), UDim2.new(0,20,0,24), C(140,140,160), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)
        local sb = F.makeBox(card, UDim2.new(0,28,0,32), UDim2.new(0,70,0,24), "0.00",
            string.format("%.2f", cutterSlices[dir].start))
        F.makeLabel(card, "OUT", UDim2.new(0,104,0,32), UDim2.new(0,28,0,24), C(140,140,160), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)
        local eb = F.makeBox(card, UDim2.new(0,134,0,32), UDim2.new(0,70,0,24), "0.00",
            string.format("%.2f", cutterSlices[dir].stop))
        Cut.startBoxes[dir], Cut.stopBoxes[dir] = sb, eb
        sb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            local n = tonumber(sb.Text)
            if n then cutterSlices[d].start = math.max(0, n) end
            Cut.drawSlices()
        end)
        eb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            local n = tonumber(eb.Text)
            if n then cutterSlices[d].stop = math.max(0, n) end
            Cut.drawSlices()
        end)

        local goIn = F.makeBtn(card, "GO IN", UDim2.new(0,212,0,32), UDim2.new(0,64,0,24), C(45,40,60), nil, 9)
        local goOut = F.makeBtn(card, "GO OUT", UDim2.new(0,280,0,32), UDim2.new(0,64,0,24), C(45,40,60), nil, 9)
        goIn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            selectDir(d); Cut.setPlaying(false); Cut.seek(cutterSlices[d].start)
        end)
        goOut.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            selectDir(d); Cut.setPlaying(false); Cut.seek(cutterSlices[d].stop)
        end)
    end

    -- placeholder text shows what a blank note will actually use
    Cut.refreshIdBoxes = function()
        for _, dir in ipairs(ARROW_ORDER) do
            local b = Cut.idBoxes[dir]
            if b then
                b.PlaceholderText = (cutterAnimId ~= "")
                    and ("default: " .. cutterAnimId) or "type an animation ID"
            end
        end
    end
    Cut.refreshIdBoxes()

    -- ── quick split ──
    local qY = nY + 4 * CARD + 4
    local split = F.makeBtn(pg, "SPLIT THIS ANIM INTO 4", UDim2.new(0,8,0,qY), UDim2.new(0,250,0,30), C(70,120,255), nil, 10)
    split.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if Cut.length <= 0 then F.notify("Load an animation first", "warn"); return end
        -- splits the animation on screen across every note that uses it
        local users = {}
        for _, dir in ipairs(ARROW_ORDER) do
            if F.cutterSliceId(dir) == Cut.editId then table.insert(users, dir) end
        end
        if #users == 0 then return end
        local q = Cut.length / #users
        for n, dir in ipairs(users) do
            cutterSlices[dir].start = (n - 1) * q
            cutterSlices[dir].stop = n * q
        end
        Cut.drawSlices()
        F.notify("Split across " .. #users .. " note" .. (#users == 1 and "" or "s"), "success")
    end)
    local clear = F.makeBtn(pg, "RESET TIMES", UDim2.new(0,266,0,qY), UDim2.new(0,130,0,30), C(170,35,35), nil, 10)
    clear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, dir in ipairs(ARROW_ORDER) do cutterSlices[dir].start, cutterSlices[dir].stop = 0, 0 end
        Cut.drawSlices()
    end)

    F.makeLabel(pg, "Your note keys play these slices while the cutter is ON.",
        UDim2.new(0,8,0,qY+38), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,16), C(120,120,140), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)

    -- ── response ──
    local rY = qY + 62
    F.makeDivider(pg, rY, THEMES[currentThemeName].accent)
    local rTitle = F.makeLabel(pg, "RESPONSE", UDim2.new(0,8,0,rY+6), UDim2.new(0,120,0,18),
        C(255,80,180), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 11)
    rTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    F.regText(rTitle)
    F.makeLabel(pg, "How fast a slice lands when you press. Lower is snappier for fast playing.",
        UDim2.new(0,8,0,rY+24), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,14), C(130,130,150), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)

    local snapBtn = F.makeBtn(pg, Cut.snap and "SNAP: ON" or "SNAP: OFF",
        UDim2.new(0,8,0,rY+44), UDim2.new(0,126,0,26),
        Cut.snap and C(255,160,40) or C(35,35,55), nil, 9)
    snapBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Cut.snap = not Cut.snap
        snapBtn.Text = Cut.snap and "SNAP: ON" or "SNAP: OFF"
        snapBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Cut.snap and C(255,160,40) or C(35,35,55)
    end)
    F.makeLabel(pg, "Skip the motion and land on the pose instantly.",
        UDim2.new(0,142,0,rY+44), UDim2.new(1,-150,0,26), C(120,120,140), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)

    F.makeLabel(pg, "REACH TIME", UDim2.new(0,8,0,rY+78), UDim2.new(0,200,0,18),
        C(160,160,160), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 10)
    local reachLbl = F.makeLabel(pg, string.format("%.2fs", Cut.reach),
        UDim2.new(0,306,0,rY+78), UDim2.new(0,90,0,18), C(255,80,180), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, 10)
    F.regText(reachLbl)
    F.makeSlider(pg, UDim2.new(0,8,0,rY+98), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,12), 0.02, 0.6, Cut.reach, function(v)
        Cut.reach = v
        reachLbl.Text = string.format("%.2fs", v)
    end)

    -- ── reverse ──
    local rvY = rY + 124
    F.makeLabel(pg, "PLAY IT BACK", UDim2.new(0,8,0,rvY), UDim2.new(0,200,0,18),
        C(160,160,160), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 10)
    local rvHelp = {
        OFF     = "Stays on the pose (Pose Hold still applies).",
        AUTO    = "Lands, pauses, then goes back to its start on its own.",
        RELEASE = "Holds while you hold the key, goes back when you let go.",
    }
    local rvBtn = F.makeBtn(pg, "", UDim2.new(0,8,0,rvY+20), UDim2.new(0,160,0,26), C(35,35,55), nil, 10)
    local rvNote = F.makeLabel(pg, "", UDim2.new(0,176,0,rvY+20), UDim2.new(1,-184,0,26),
        C(120,120,140), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)
    rvNote.TextWrapped = true
    local function syncRv()
        rvBtn.Text = "REVERSE: " .. (Cut.reverse == "RELEASE" and "ON RELEASE" or Cut.reverse)
        rvBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (Cut.reverse == "OFF") and C(35,35,55) or C(255,160,40)
        rvNote.Text = rvHelp[Cut.reverse] or ""
    end
    rvBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local order = { "OFF", "AUTO", "RELEASE" }
        Cut.reverse = order[((table.find(order, Cut.reverse) or 1) % #order) + 1]
        syncRv()
    end)
    syncRv()

    local rvRows = {
        { key = "returnPause", label = "PAUSE ON THE POSE (AUTO)", min = 0,    max = 1.5, fmt = "%.2fs" },
        { key = "returnTime",  label = "TIME TO GO BACK",          min = 0.03, max = 1.5, fmt = "%.2fs" },
    }
    for i, s in ipairs(rvRows) do
        local ry = rvY + 54 + (i-1) * 42
        F.makeLabel(pg, s.label, UDim2.new(0,8,0,ry), UDim2.new(0,240,0,18), C(160,160,160), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 10)
        local v = F.makeLabel(pg, string.format(s.fmt, Cut[s.key]), UDim2.new(0,306,0,ry), UDim2.new(0,90,0,18),
            C(255,80,180), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, 10)
        F.regText(v)
        local ck, cf = s.key, s.fmt
        F.makeSlider(pg, UDim2.new(0,8,0,ry+20), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,12), s.min, s.max, Cut[s.key], function(val)
            Cut[ck] = val
            v.Text = string.format(cf, val)
        end)
    end

    local haY = rvY + 54 + #rvRows * 42
    local haBtn = F.makeBtn(pg, "", UDim2.new(0,8,0,haY), UDim2.new(0,190,0,26), C(35,35,55), nil, 9)
    local haNote = F.makeLabel(pg, "", UDim2.new(0,206,0,haY), UDim2.new(1,-214,0,26),
        C(120,120,140), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)
    haNote.TextWrapped = true
    local function syncHa()
        haBtn.Text = Cut.holdAfterReturn and "AFTER GOING BACK: HOLD" or "AFTER GOING BACK: IDLE"
        haBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Cut.holdAfterReturn and C(255,160,40) or C(35,35,55)
        haNote.Text = Cut.holdAfterReturn and "Stays on the start frame. Pose Hold sets how long."
            or "Blends out to idle once it's back."
    end
    haBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Cut.holdAfterReturn = not Cut.holdAfterReturn
        syncHa()
    end)
    syncHa()

    Cut.startLoop()
    task.defer(function()
        Cut.buildClone()
        selectDir(Cut.selDir or "LEFT")
    end)
end

                secCurrentLbl.Text = "§ " .. sec.name

                end

                if #sections <= 1 then F.notify("Need at least one section", "warn"); return end

                if currentSectionIdx > #sections then currentSectionIdx = #sections end
                buildSectionsUI()
            end)

            local dirOrder = { "LEFT", "DOWN", "UP", "RIGHT" }
            for di, dir in ipairs(dirOrder) do
                local dy = 30 + (di-1) * 22
                local col = ARROW_COLORS[dir] and ARROW_COLORS[dir].hit or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                F.makeLabel(card, dir, UDim2.new(0,6,0,dy), UDim2.new(0,42,0,20), col, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)

                idBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                    local cleaned = idBox.Text:gsub("%D","")
                    sec.ids[capturedDir] = cleaned ~= "" and cleaned or "0"
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    F.refreshSectionsUI = function()
        secCurrentLbl.Text = "§ " .. (sections[currentSectionIdx] and sections[currentSectionIdx].name or "—")
        buildSectionsUI()
    end

    local addSecBtn = F.makeBtn(pg2, "+ NEW SECTION", UDim2.new(0,8,0,756), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,28), Color3.fromRGB(35,35,55), nil, 11)
    addSecBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        buildSectionsUI()
        F.notify("Added new section", "success")
    end)

    local dupSecBtn = F.makeBtn(pg2, "📋 DUPLICATE CURRENT", UDim2.new(0,8,0,790), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,28), Color3.fromRGB(70,120,255), nil, 11)
    dupSecBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local src = sections[currentSectionIdx]
        if not src then return end
        local copy = { name = src.name .. " (copy)", ids = {} }
        for dir, id in pairs(src.ids) do copy.ids[dir] = id end
        table.insert(sections, currentSectionIdx + 1, copy)
        buildSectionsUI()
        F.notify("Duplicated § " .. src.name, "success")
    end)

    buildSectionsUI()
end

    local title = F.makeLabel(pg, "VIDEO PLAYER", UDim2.new(0,8,0,6), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,22),

    -- ── what this executor can do ──
    local caps = F.makeLabel(pg, "", UDim2.new(0,8,0,48), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,16),
        C(160,160,180), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 10)
    local function refreshCaps()
        local a = Vid.api.asset and "YES" or "NO"
        local l = Vid.api.list and "YES" or "NO"
        caps.Text = "local video support: " .. a .. "   |   folder listing: " .. l

    end

    F.makeDivider(pg, 70, THEMES[currentThemeName].accent)
    local dropHdr = F.makeLabel(pg, "YOUR VIDEOS", UDim2.new(0,8,0,76), UDim2.new(0,160,0,18),
        C(255,80,180), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 11)
    dropHdr.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    F.regText(dropHdr)

    local howTo = F.makeLabel(pg,
        "Drag a .webm file into this folder in Windows Explorer, then press REFRESH:\n"
        .. "your executor's  workspace / " .. Vid.folder,
        UDim2.new(0,8,0,96), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,32), C(200,200,215), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)
    howTo.TextWrapped = true

    local refresh = F.makeBtn(pg, "REFRESH", UDim2.new(1,-100,0,74), UDim2.new(0,92,0,22), C(70,120,255), nil, 9)

    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    list.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,130); list.Position = UDim2.new(0,8,0,132)
    list.BackgroundColor3 = C(12,11,18); list.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
    list.BorderSizePixel = 0; list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.Parent = pg
    F.uiCorner(list, UDim.new(0,8))
    local ll = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); ll.Padding = UDim.new(0,3); ll.Parent = list
    local lp = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    lp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,4); lp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,4); lp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,4)
    lp.Parent = list

    local function row(text, color, order)
        local l = F.makeLabel(list, text, UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), UDim2.new(1,-8,0,0),
            color, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9)
        l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        l.TextWrapped = true
        l.LayoutOrder = order
        return l
    end

    local function fill()
        for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
        end
        if not Vid.api.list then
            row("Your executor can't list folders. Type the file name below instead.", C(255,170,80), 1)
            return
        end
        local files = Vid.listFiles()
        if #files == 0 then
            row("Nothing here yet. Drop a .webm into the folder above and press REFRESH.", C(140,140,160), 1)
            return
        end
        for i, f in ipairs(files) do
            local playable = (f.ext == "webm")
            local b = F.makeBtn(list,
                (playable and "▶  " or "⚠  ") .. f.name .. (playable and "" or "   (convert to .webm)"),
                UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), UDim2.new(1,-8,0,26),
                playable and C(34,32,48) or C(55,35,30), nil, 10)
            b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            b.LayoutOrder = i
            local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,10); pad.Parent = b
            local path = f.path
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Vid.play(path) end)
        end
    end
    refresh.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Vid.resolveApi(); refreshCaps(); fill()
    end)
    fill()

    -- ── manual entry: a file name, or a Roblox video ID ──
    local manual = F.makeBox(pg, UDim2.new(0,8,0,270), UDim2.new(1,-114,0,28),

    manualGo.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local t = manual.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        if t:match("^%d+$") then
            Vid.play(t, true)                    -- a Roblox-hosted video
        else
            local path = t:find("/") and t or (Vid.folder .. "/" .. t)
            Vid.play(path)
        end
    end)

    Vid.statusLbl = F.makeLabel(pg, "pick a video", UDim2.new(0,8,0,302), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,28),

    local function tb(txt, x, w, col, fn)
        local b = F.makeBtn(pg, txt, UDim2.new(0,x,0,trY), UDim2.new(0,w,0,28), col, nil, 10)
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fn)

    tb("RESTART", 140, 90, C(45,40,60), Vid.restart)
    tb("STOP", 236, 70, C(190,50,50), Vid.stop)

        Vid.looped = not Vid.looped
        if Vid.frame then Vid.frame.Looped = Vid.looped end
        loopB.Text = Vid.looped and "LOOP: ON" or "LOOP: OFF"

        -- what the stage is actually drawing right now
        local function part(e, label, expected)
            if not expected then return label .. ": not set" end
            if not e then return label .. ": copy FAILED" end
            return string.format("%s: %d parts", label, #e.map)
        end
        local me, op = Vid.stage.me, Vid.stage.opp
        sgInfo.Text = part(me, "you", character ~= nil) .. "   |   "

        for k, b in pairs(dirBtns) do

        end

        { key = "cheerTime",  label = "CHEER LENGTH (WIN)", min = 1,  max = 10,  fmt = "%.1fs" },
    }

            Result[rr.key] = val
            v.Text = fmtRow(rr, val)
        end)
    end

    F.makeLabel(pg, "Your own physics, so other players see the fling. Careful near edges: it can throw you off the map.",
        UDim2.new(0,8,0,lY + 118 + #rows * 42 + 4), UDim2.new(1,-16,0,28), C(255,170,80), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 9).TextWrapped = true

scripts.features:
## Playing on mobile

On a phone or tablet, four big arrows appear along the bottom of your screen, split into two pairs like FNF on mobile: ← ↓ on the left and ↑ → on the right, with a gap in the middle so you can still see the stage.

- **Tap for a pose, hold for a hold streak.** Each arrow does exactly what its key does on PC.
- **Multi-touch.** Hit two arrows at once for double notes, or hold one while tapping another.
- **Lights up when you hit it.** Arrows sit grey until you tap them, then flash in their note's color.
- **Never gets stuck.** Lift your finger anywhere and the note lets go, even if you slid off the arrow.
- **Fits any screen.** The arrows re-fit themselves when you rotate your phone.

Everything from PC works the same on mobile: the emote cutter, the cinematic camera, the health bar, hold streaks, and win or lose.

**Make them fit your thumbs.** In **Settings → Mobile Arrows** you can change the arrow size, the gap between the pairs, the gap inside a pair, how high they sit, and how see-through they are when you're not touching them.

The arrows show up on their own on phones and tablets and hide when you're using a keyboard. You can also switch them **On** to always show them, or **Off** to hide them.

--========================================================
local ESPObjects = {}
local function RemoveESP(Player)
    local Data = ESPObjects[Player]
    if not Data then
        return
    end
    if Data.HealthConnection then
        Data.HealthConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    if Data.Highlight then
        Data.Highlight:Destroy()
    end
    if Data.Beam then
        Data.Beam:Destroy()
    end
    if Data.LocalAttachment then
        Data.LocalAttachment:Destroy()
    end
    if Data.TargetAttachment then
        Data.TargetAttachment:Destroy()
    end
    if Data.Billboard then
        Data.Billboard:Destroy()
    end
    ESPObjects[Player] = nil
end
local function CreateESP(Player)
    if Player == LocalPlayer then

        return
    end
    if not ESPEnabled then
        return
    end
    local Character =
        Player.Character
    local LocalCharacter =
        LocalPlayer.Character
    if not Character or not LocalCharacter then
        return
    end
    local TargetRoot =
        Character:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )
    local LocalRoot =
        LocalCharacter:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )
    local Humanoid =
        Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
            "Humanoid"
        )
    if not TargetRoot
        or not LocalRoot
        or not Humanoid then
        return
    end
    RemoveESP(Player)
    --====================================================
    -- GREEN BOX
    --====================================================
    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    Highlight.Name =
        "LegacyESP_Box"
    Highlight.Adornee =
        Character
    Highlight.FillColor =
        ESP_COLOR
    Highlight.FillTransparency =
        0.85

    Highlight.OutlineColor =
        ESP_COLOR
    Highlight.OutlineTransparency =
        0
    Highlight.DepthMode =
        Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    Highlight.Parent =
        Character
    --====================================================
    -- GREEN LINE
    --====================================================
    local LocalAttachment =
        Instance.new("Attachment")
    LocalAttachment.Name =
        "LegacyESP_Origin"
    LocalAttachment.Parent =
        LocalRoot
    local TargetAttachment =
        Instance.new("Attachment")
    TargetAttachment.Name =
        "LegacyESP_Target"
    TargetAttachment.Parent =
        TargetRoot
    local Beam =
        Instance.new("Beam")
    Beam.Name =
        "LegacyESP_Line"
    Beam.Attachment0 =
        LocalAttachment
    Beam.Attachment1 =
        TargetAttachment
    Beam.FaceCamera = true
    Beam.LightEmission = 1
    Beam.LightInfluence = 0
    Beam.Width0 = 0.08
    Beam.Width1 = 0.08
    Beam.Color =
        ColorSequence.new(
            ESP_COLOR

        )
    Beam.Transparency =
        NumberSequence.new(0)
    Beam.Parent =
        LocalRoot
    --====================================================
    -- NAME + HP
    --====================================================
    local Billboard =
        Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    Billboard.Name =
        "LegacyESP_Info"
    Billboard.Adornee =
        TargetRoot
    Billboard.Size =
        UDim2.fromOffset(200, 48)
    Billboard.StudsOffset =
        Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
    Billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    Billboard.MaxDistance = 10000
    Billboard.Parent =
        Character
    --====================================================
    -- NAME
    --====================================================
    local NameLabel =
        Instance.new("TextLabel")
    NameLabel.Size =
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
    NameLabel.Position =
        UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    NameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    NameLabel.Text =
        Player.DisplayName ..
        "  @" ..
        Player.Name
    NameLabel.TextColor3 =
        ESP_COLOR
    NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 =

        Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    NameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    NameLabel.TextSize = 13
    NameLabel.Font =
        Enum.Font.GothamBold
    NameLabel.TextXAlignment =
        Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    NameLabel.Parent =
        Billboard
    --====================================================
    -- HP
    --====================================================
    local HPLabel =
        Instance.new("TextLabel")
    HPLabel.Size =
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
    HPLabel.Position =
        UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
    HPLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    HPLabel.TextColor3 =
        ESP_COLOR
    HPLabel.TextStrokeColor3 =
        Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    HPLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    HPLabel.TextSize = 12
    HPLabel.Font =
        Enum.Font.GothamBold
    HPLabel.TextXAlignment =
        Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    HPLabel.Parent =
        Billboard
    local function UpdateHealth()
        if not Humanoid
            or not Humanoid.Parent then
            return
        end
        local Health =
            math.max(

                0,
                math.floor(
                    Humanoid.Health + 0.5
                )
            )
        local MaxHealth =
            math.max(
                0,
                math.floor(
                    Humanoid.MaxHealth + 0.5
                )
            )
        HPLabel.Text =
            "HP: " ..
            Health ..
            " / " ..
            MaxHealth
        local Percent = 0
        if MaxHealth > 0 then
            Percent =
                Health / MaxHealth
        end
        if Percent > 0.6 then
            HPLabel.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    0,
                    255,
                    80
                )
        elseif Percent > 0.3 then
            HPLabel.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    255,
                    220,
                    0
                )
        else
            HPLabel.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    255,
                    60,
                    60
                )
        end
    end

    UpdateHealth()
    local HealthConnection =
        Humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(
            UpdateHealth
        )
    ESPObjects[Player] = {
        Highlight = Highlight,
        Beam = Beam,
        LocalAttachment =
            LocalAttachment,
        TargetAttachment =
            TargetAttachment,
        Billboard =
            Billboard,
        HealthConnection =
            HealthConnection
    }
end
local function EnableESP()
    for _, Player in
        ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            task.spawn(function()
                CreateESP(Player)
            end)
        end
    end
end
local function DisableESP()
    for Player in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        RemoveESP(Player)
    end
end
local function RefreshESP()
    if not ESPEnabled then
        return

    end
    DisableESP()
    EnableESP()
end
ESPToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ESPEnabled = not ESPEnabled
    ToggleVisual(
        ESPToggle,
        ESPToggleStroke,
        "ESP",
        ESPEnabled
    )
    if ESPEnabled then
        EnableESP()
    else
        DisableESP()
    end
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
    Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        if ESPEnabled then
            CreateESP(Player)
        end
    end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
    RemoveESP(Player)
end)

local OriginalCollision = {}
local function SetNoclip(State)
    local Character =
        GetCharacter()
    if not Character then
        return

    for _, Part in
        ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
        if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if State then
                if OriginalCollision[Part] == nil then
                    OriginalCollision[Part] =
                        Part.CanCollide

                end
                Part.CanCollide = false
            else
                if OriginalCollision[Part] ~= nil then
                    Part.CanCollide =
                        OriginalCollision[Part]
                    OriginalCollision[Part] = nil

        end
    end

    local Camera =

    local Direction =

            Direction.Unit *

local function IsValidTarget(Player)
    if not Player
        or Player == LocalPlayer then
        return false
    end
    local Character =
        Player.Character
    if not Character then
        return false
    end
    local Humanoid =
        Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
            "Humanoid"
        )
    local Root =
        Character:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )
    if not Humanoid or not Root then
        return false
    end
    if Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return false
    end
    return true
end
local function GetNearestTarget()
    local MyCharacter =
        GetCharacter()
    if not MyCharacter then
        return nil
    end
    local MyRoot =
        MyCharacter:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )
    if not MyRoot then
        return nil
    end
    local NearestPlayer = nil
    local NearestDistance =
        AIMBOT_RANGE

    for _, Player in
        ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if IsValidTarget(Player) then
            local Root =
                Player.Character:
                FindFirstChild(
                    "HumanoidRootPart"
                )
            if Root then
                local Distance =
                    (
                        Root.Position -
                        MyRoot.Position
                    ).Magnitude
                if Distance <
                    NearestDistance then
                    NearestDistance =
                        Distance
                    NearestPlayer =
                        Player
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return NearestPlayer
end
local function UpdateTarget()
    if not IsValidTarget(
        CurrentTarget

        CurrentTarget =
            GetNearestTarget()

    if CurrentTarget then

    local Character =

    local TargetRoot =

    local Camera =
        workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not TargetRoot

    local DesiredCFrame =

        )
    Camera.CFrame =
        Camera.CFrame:Lerp(
            DesiredCFrame,

    TargetLabel.Text =

--========================================================
-- DRAG ALL GUI PANELS EXCEPT KEY SYSTEM
--========================================================
local function MakeDraggable(Frame, Handle, Companion)
    if not Frame or not Handle then
        return
    end

    Handle.Active = true

    local IsDragging = false
    local DragStartPosition
    local FrameStartPosition

    Handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)
        if Input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and
            Input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end

        IsDragging = true
        DragStartPosition = Input.Position
        FrameStartPosition = Frame.Position

        local Connection
        Connection = Input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if Input.UserInputState ==
                Enum.UserInputState.End then
                IsDragging = false
                if Connection then
                    Connection:Disconnect()
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
        if not IsDragging then
            return
        end

        if Input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            and
            Input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end

        local Delta =
            Input.Position -
            DragStartPosition

        Frame.Position =
            UDim2.new(
                FrameStartPosition.X.Scale,
                FrameStartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
                FrameStartPosition.Y.Scale,
                FrameStartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
            )

        if Companion then
            Companion.Position =
                UDim2.new(
                    Frame.Position.X.Scale,
                    Frame.Position.X.Offset + 96,
                    Frame.Position.Y.Scale,
                    Frame.Position.Y.Offset + 248
                )
        end
    end)
end

local function stopFlying()

	flying = false
	flyButton.Text = "FLY: OFF"

	if flyConnection then

		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil

	end

	local character = player.Character

	if character then

		local humanoid =
			character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if humanoid then

			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
			humanoid.AutoRotate = true

		end
	end
end

local function startFlying()

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local root =
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local humanoid =
		character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	flying = true
	flyButton.Text = "FLY: ON"

	humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	flyConnection =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

			if not flying or not root.Parent then

				stopFlying()
				return

			end

			local moveDirection =
				humanoid.MoveDirection

			if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then

				local camera =
					workspace.CurrentCamera

				local lookDirection =
					camera.CFrame.LookVector

				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					lookDirection.Unit * flySpeed

				root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
					root.Position,
					root.Position + lookDirection
				)

			else

				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
					Vector3.zero

			end

		end)
end

flyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if flying then
		stopFlying()
	else
		startFlying()
	end

end)

flySpeedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()

	end

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- ESP
--------------------------------------------------

local function getHealthColor(health, maxHealth)

	if health <= 0 then
		return Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255)

	end

	local percentage =
		health / maxHealth

	if percentage <= 0.25 then

		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

	elseif percentage <= 0.50 then

		return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)

	else

		return Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)

	end
end

local function addESP(target)

	if target == player then return end

	local character =
		target.Character

	if not character then return end

	local humanoid =
		character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid then return end

	if espObjects[target] then
		return
	end

	local highlight =
		Instance.new("Highlight")

	highlight.Adornee = character
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
	highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	highlight.Parent = character

	local billboard =
		Instance.new("BillboardGui")

	billboard.Size =
		UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 45)

	billboard.StudsOffset =
		Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.Adornee = character
	billboard.Parent = character

	local label =
		Instance.new("TextLabel")

	label.Size =
		UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Parent = billboard

	local function updateESP()

		local health =
			math.max(0, humanoid.Health)

		local maxHealth =
			humanoid.MaxHealth

		local color =
			getHealthColor(
				health,
				maxHealth
			)

		label.Text =
			target.Name ..
			" [" ..
			math.floor(health) ..
			"/" ..
			math.floor(maxHealth) ..
			"]"

		label.TextColor3 = color

		highlight.FillColor = color
		highlight.OutlineColor = RED

	end

	updateESP()

	local connection =
		humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(
			updateESP
		)

	espObjects[target] = {

		highlight = highlight,
		billboard = billboard,
		connection = connection

	}

end

local function removeESP(target)

	local data =
		espObjects[target]

	if not data then return end

	if data.connection then
		data.connection:Disconnect()
	end

	if data.highlight then
		data.highlight:Destroy()
	end

	if data.billboard then
		data.billboard:Destroy()
	end

	espObjects[target] = nil

end

local function enableESP()

	espEnabled = true
	espButton.Text = "ESP: ON"

	for _, target in
		ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		addESP(target)

	end
end

local function disableESP()

	espEnabled = false
	espButton.Text = "ESP: OFF"

	for _, target in
		ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		removeESP(target)

	end
end

espButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if espEnabled then
		disableESP()
	else
		enableESP()
	end

end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(target)

	target.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

		if espEnabled then

			task.wait(0.5)
			addESP(target)

		end

	end)

end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(target)

	removeESP(target)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- NOCLIP
--------------------------------------------------

local function setNoclip(enabled)

	noclip = enabled

	noclipButton.Text =
		"NOCLIP: " ..
		(enabled and "ON" or "OFF")

	if noclipConnection then

		noclipConnection:Disconnect()
		noclipConnection = nil

	end

	if enabled then

		noclipConnection =
			RunService.Stepped:Connect(
				function()

					local character =
						player.Character

					if not character then
						return
					end

					for _, part in
						ipairs(
							character:GetDescendants()
						) do

						if part:IsA("BasePart") then
							part.CanCollide = false
						end

					end

				end
			)

	end
end

noclipButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	setNoclip(not noclip)

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- WALK FLING
--------------------------------------------------

local function flingTarget(target)

	if not walkFling then return end

	local character =
		target.Character

	if not character then return end

	local targetRoot =
		character:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	local myCharacter =
		player.Character

	if not myCharacter or not targetRoot then
		return
	end

	local myRoot =
		myCharacter:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if not myRoot then return end

	if flingCooldown[target] then
		return
	end

	flingCooldown[target] = true

	local direction =
		targetRoot.Position -
		myRoot.Position

	if direction.Magnitude > 0 then

		direction =
			direction.Unit

		targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
			direction * 100 +
			Vector3.new(0, 60, 0)

	end

	task.delay(0.5, function()

		flingCooldown[target] = nil

	end)

end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

	if not walkFling then return end

	local character =
		player.Character

	if not character then return end

	local root =
		character:FindFirstChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart"
		)

	if not root then return end

	for _, target in
		ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		if target ~= player then

			local targetCharacter =
				target.Character

			if targetCharacter then

				local targetRoot =
					targetCharacter:FindFirstChild(
						"HumanoidRootPart"
					)

				if targetRoot then

					local distance =
						(
							root.Position -
							targetRoot.Position
						).Magnitude

					if distance <= 4 then
						flingTarget(target)
					end

				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

flingButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	walkFling = not walkFling

	flingButton.Text =
		"WALK FLING: " ..
		(walkFling and "ON" or "OFF")

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- MINIMIZE
--------------------------------------------------

minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	menu.Visible = false
	reopen.Visible = true

end)

reopen.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	menu.Visible = true
	reopen.Visible = false

end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- DRAGGING
--------------------------------------------------

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

title.Active = true

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true

		dragStart =
			input.Position

		startPosition =
			menu.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if input.UserInputState ==
				Enum.UserInputState.End then

				dragging = false

			end

		end)

	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not dragging then return end

	if input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta =
			input.Position -
			dragStart

		menu.Position =
			UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)

	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- RESPAWN
--------------------------------------------------

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	task.wait(0.5)

	applyMovement()

	if noclip then
		setNoclip(true)
	end

	if espEnabled then

		for _, target in
			ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

			if target ~= player then
				addESP(target)
			end

		end

	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- KEEP MOVEMENT
--------------------------------------------------

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

	local character =
		player.Character

	if not character then return end

	local humanoid =
		character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	if humanoid then

		humanoid.WalkSpeed =
			walkSpeed

		humanoid.UseJumpPower = true

		humanoid.JumpPower =
			jumpPower

	end
end)

	LoadingSubtitle = "ISOXTERIA",
	ConfigurationSaving = {
		Enabled = true,
		FolderName = "AIMBOT",
		FileName = "FlyConfig"
	},
	Discord = { Enabled = false },
	KeySystem = false
})

local FlightTab = Window:CreateTab("Flight Controls", 4483362458)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Flying = false
local FlySpeed = 50
local BoostMultiplier = 2.5
local BoostCooldown = 1.2
local CanBoost = true
local NoclipWhileFlying = false
local EnableAnimations = true
local EnableTrail = true
local DynamicFOV = true

local Attachment, LinearVelocity, AlignOrientation
local CurrentVelocity = Vector3.zero
local TargetVelocity = Vector3.zero
local CurrentLean = 0
local CurrentTilt = 0
local CurrentRoll = 0
local BobTimer = 0

local TrailInstance = nil
local Attachment0, Attachment1
local DefaultFOV = 70

-- Dynamic Universal Arm Joint Variables (Supports R6, R15 & Custom Rigs)
local LeftShoulder, RightShoulder
local OriginalLeftC0, OriginalRightC0
local CurrentChar = nil

local function getCharacterParts()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
		return char, hum, root, torso
	end
	return nil, nil, nil, nil
end

-- Universal Joint Finder (Scans Rig Structure for Shoulders)
local function SetupArmJoints()
	local char = getCharacterParts()
	if not char then return end

	-- Clear previous references if character reset
	if char ~= CurrentChar then
		CurrentChar = char
		LeftShoulder = nil
		RightShoulder = nil
		OriginalLeftC0 = nil
		OriginalRightC0 = nil
	end

	if LeftShoulder and RightShoulder then return end

	-- Dynamic Search across all descendants for Motor6D Shoulder Joints
	for _, v in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
			local name = v.Name:lower()
			if (name:find("left") or name:find("l_")) and (name:find("shoulder") or name:find("arm")) then
				if not LeftShoulder then LeftShoulder = v end
			elseif (name:find("right") or name:find("r_")) and (name:find("shoulder") or name:find("arm")) then
				if not RightShoulder then RightShoulder = v end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Fallback check for standard Roblox Rig naming
	if not LeftShoulder then
		LeftShoulder = char:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder", true)
	end
	if not RightShoulder then
		RightShoulder = char:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder", true) or char:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder", true)
	end

	-- Cache original C0 positions
	if LeftShoulder and not OriginalLeftC0 then
		OriginalLeftC0 = LeftShoulder.C0
	end
	if RightShoulder and not OriginalRightC0 then
		OriginalRightC0 = RightShoulder.C0
	end
end

local function ResetArmJoints()
	if LeftShoulder and OriginalLeftC0 then
		TweenService:Create(LeftShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {C0 = OriginalLeftC0}):Play()
	end
	if RightShoulder and OriginalRightC0 then
		TweenService:Create(RightShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {C0 = OriginalRightC0}):Play()
	end
end

local function ApplySupermanPose(isMovingForward)
	if not LeftShoulder or not RightShoulder then return end
	if not OriginalLeftC0 or not OriginalRightC0 then return end

	if isMovingForward and EnableAnimations then
		-- Universal Superman Arm Pose Offset (Works across R6, R15, Rthro)
		local leftTargetC0 = OriginalLeftC0 * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(175), math.rad(-5), math.rad(5))
		local rightTargetC0 = OriginalRightC0 * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(175), math.rad(5), math.rad(-5))

		TweenService:Create(LeftShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {C0 = leftTargetC0}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(RightShoulder, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {C0 = rightTargetC0}):Play()
	else
		ResetArmJoints()
	end
end

-- Create Sonic Shockwave Effect
local function SpawnShockwave(position, direction)
	local shockwave = Instance.new("Part")
	shockwave.Name = "SonicShockwave"
	shockwave.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	shockwave.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 2, 2)
	shockwave.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	shockwave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
	shockwave.Transparency = 0.25
	shockwave.Anchored = true
	shockwave.CanCollide = false
	shockwave.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
	shockwave.Parent = Workspace

	local innerRing = shockwave:Clone()
	innerRing.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	innerRing.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 1, 1)
	innerRing.Parent = Workspace

	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	
	local outerTween = TweenService:Create(shockwave, tweenInfo, {
		Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 40, 40),
		Transparency = 1
	})
	local innerTween = TweenService:Create(innerRing, tweenInfo, {
		Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 25, 25),
		Transparency = 1
	})

	outerTween:Play()
	innerTween:Play()

	outerTween.Completed:Connect(function()
		shockwave:Destroy()
		innerRing:Destroy()
	end)
end

local function SetupTrail(rootPart)
	if TrailInstance then TrailInstance:Destroy() end
	if Attachment0 then Attachment0:Destroy() end
	if Attachment1 then Attachment1:Destroy() end

	Attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	Attachment0.Position = Vector3.new(-1.5, 0, 0)
	Attachment0.Parent = rootPart

	Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	Attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(1.5, 0, 0)
	Attachment1.Parent = rootPart

	TrailInstance = Instance.new("Trail")
	TrailInstance.Attachment0 = Attachment0
	TrailInstance.Attachment1 = Attachment1
	TrailInstance.Lifetime = 0.35
	TrailInstance.MinLength = 0.1
	TrailInstance.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
	})
	TrailInstance.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255), Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 255))
	TrailInstance.Enabled = EnableTrail
	TrailInstance.Parent = rootPart
end

local function TriggerShockwaveBoost()
	if not Flying or not CanBoost then return end

	local _, _, rootPart = getCharacterParts()
	if not rootPart then return end

	CanBoost = false

	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local boostDir = camera.CFrame.LookVector

	SpawnShockwave(rootPart.Position, boostDir)

	CurrentVelocity = boostDir * (FlySpeed * BoostMultiplier)

	if DynamicFOV then
		local startFOV = camera.FieldOfView
		TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {FieldOfView = math.min(startFOV + 25, 120)}):Play()
		task.delay(0.12, function()
			TweenService:Create(camera, TweenInfo.new(0.35), {FieldOfView = startFOV}):Play()
		end)
	end

	task.delay(BoostCooldown, function()
		CanBoost = true
	end)
end

local function EnableFly()
	local char, humanoid, rootPart = getCharacterParts()
	if not rootPart or not humanoid then return end

	Flying = true
	humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)

	SetupArmJoints()

	Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	Attachment.Name = "FlyAttachment"
	Attachment.Parent = rootPart

	LinearVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	LinearVelocity.MaxForce = 1e8
	LinearVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
	LinearVelocity.Attachment0 = Attachment
	LinearVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	LinearVelocity.Parent = rootPart

	AlignOrientation = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	AlignOrientation.MaxTorque = 1e8
	AlignOrientation.MaxAngularVelocity = 150
	AlignOrientation.Responsiveness = 250
	AlignOrientation.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	AlignOrientation.Attachment0 = Attachment
	AlignOrientation.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame
	AlignOrientation.Parent = rootPart

	SetupTrail(rootPart)
	DefaultFOV = Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView
end

local function DisableFly()
	Flying = false
	CurrentVelocity = Vector3.zero
	TargetVelocity = Vector3.zero
	CurrentLean = 0
	CurrentTilt = 0
	CurrentRoll = 0
	BobTimer = 0

	ResetArmJoints()

	local char, humanoid = getCharacterParts()
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, true)
	end

	if LinearVelocity then LinearVelocity:Destroy() end
	if AlignOrientation then AlignOrientation:Destroy() end
	if Attachment then Attachment:Destroy() end
	if TrailInstance then TrailInstance:Destroy() end
	if Attachment0 then Attachment0:Destroy() end
	if Attachment1 then Attachment1:Destroy() end

	TweenService:Create(Workspace.CurrentCamera, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {FieldOfView = DefaultFOV}):Play()
end

-- UI CONTROLS
local FlyToggle = FlightTab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "Enable Flight",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Flag = "FlyToggle",
	Callback = function(Value)
		if Value then EnableFly() else DisableFly() end
	end,
})

FlightTab:CreateSlider({
	Name = "Flight Speed (Studs/s)",
	Range = {10, 1000},
	Increment = 10,
	Suffix = "Studs",
	CurrentValue = 50,
	Flag = "FlySpeedSlider",
	Callback = function(Value)
		FlySpeed = Value
	end,
})

FlightTab:CreateSlider({
	Name = "Shift Boost Multiplier",
	Range = {1.5, 5},
	Increment = 0.5,
	Suffix = "x",
	CurrentValue = 2.5,
	Flag = "BoostMultiplierSlider",
	Callback = function(Value)
		BoostMultiplier = Value
	end,
})

FlightTab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "Superman Pose & Animations",
	CurrentValue = true,
	Flag = "FlyAnimToggle",
	Callback = function(Value)
		EnableAnimations = Value
		if not Value then ResetArmJoints() end
	end,
})

FlightTab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "Dynamic Speed FOV",
	CurrentValue = true,
	Flag = "DynamicFOVToggle",
	Callback = function(Value)
		DynamicFOV = Value
		if not Value then
			TweenService:Create(Workspace.CurrentCamera, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {FieldOfView = DefaultFOV}):Play()
		end
	end,
})

FlightTab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "Flight Speed Trail",
	CurrentValue = true,
	Flag = "FlyTrailToggle",
	Callback = function(Value)
		EnableTrail = Value
		if TrailInstance then
			TrailInstance.Enabled = Value
		end
	end,
})

FlightTab:CreateToggle({
	Name = "Noclip While Flying",
	CurrentValue = false,
	Flag = "NoclipFlyToggle",
	Callback = function(Value)
		NoclipWhileFlying = Value
	end,
})

FlightTab:CreateKeybind({
	Name = "Toggle Fly Keybind",
	CurrentKeybind = "E",
	HoldToInteract = false,
	Flag = "FlyKeybind",
	Callback = function()
		FlyToggle:Set(not Flying)
	end,
})

-- Listen for Shift Key Boost Press
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift and Flying then
		TriggerShockwaveBoost()
	end
end)

-- Re-hook joint listener on character respawn
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.5)
	SetupArmJoints()
end)

-- MAIN MOVEMENT & ANIMATION LOOP
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, deltaTime)
	if not Flying then return end

	local char, humanoid, rootPart = getCharacterParts()
	if not rootPart or not LinearVelocity or not AlignOrientation then return end

	if NoclipWhileFlying and char then
		for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end

	local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local rawDir = Vector3.zero

	local isW = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)
	local isS = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)
	local isA = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)
	local isD = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)

	if isW then rawDir = rawDir + Camera.CFrame.LookVector end
	if isS then rawDir = rawDir - Camera.CFrame.LookVector end
	if isA then rawDir = rawDir - Camera.CFrame.RightVector end
	if isD then rawDir = rawDir + Camera.CFrame.RightVector end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then rawDir = rawDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

	-- Smooth Velocity Calculation
	if rawDir.Magnitude > 0 then
		TargetVelocity = rawDir.Unit * FlySpeed
	else
		TargetVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	CurrentVelocity = CurrentVelocity:Lerp(TargetVelocity, math.clamp(deltaTime * 8, 0, 1))

	-- Advanced Multi-Axis Hovering Idle Animation
	BobTimer = BobTimer + deltaTime * 2.5
	local bobOffset = Vector3.zero
	local hoverJitter = Vector3.zero

	if rawDir.Magnitude == 0 and EnableAnimations then
		bobOffset = Vector3.new(
			math.cos(BobTimer * 0.8) * 0.35,
			math.sin(BobTimer * 1.5) * 0.6,
			math.sin(BobTimer * 0.5) * 0.25
		)
	elseif EnableAnimations and CurrentVelocity.Magnitude > 100 then
		-- High-speed subtle micro-vibrations for wind effect
		hoverJitter = Vector3.new(
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1,
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1,
			(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
		)
	end

	LinearVelocity.VectorVelocity = CurrentVelocity + bobOffset + hoverJitter

	-- Universal Superman Arm Pose Animation
	ApplySupermanPose(isW)

	-- Dynamic Speed FOV
	if DynamicFOV then
		local currentSpeedRatio = CurrentVelocity.Magnitude / 1000
		local targetFOV = math.clamp(DefaultFOV + (currentSpeedRatio * 35), DefaultFOV, 110)
		Camera.FieldOfView = Camera.FieldOfView + (targetFOV - Camera.FieldOfView) * math.clamp(deltaTime * 5, 0, 1)
	end

	-- Overhauled Body Pitching, Banking & Rolling Physics
	local targetLean = 0
	local targetTilt = 0
	local targetRoll = 0

	if EnableAnimations then
		if isW then 
			targetLean = math.rad(-80) -- Full horizontal Superman stance
		end
		if isS then 
			targetLean = math.rad(30) 
		end
		if isA then 
			targetTilt = math.rad(22)
			targetRoll = math.rad(-25) -- Banking roll into turns
		end
		if isD then 
			targetTilt = math.rad(-22)
			targetRoll = math.rad(25) -- Banking roll into turns
		end
	end

	CurrentLean = CurrentLean + (targetLean - CurrentLean) * math.clamp(deltaTime * 9, 0, 1)
	CurrentTilt = CurrentTilt + (targetTilt - CurrentTilt) * math.clamp(deltaTime * 9, 0, 1)
	CurrentRoll = CurrentRoll + (targetRoll - CurrentRoll) * math.clamp(deltaTime * 9, 0, 1)

	local camLook = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local flatLook = Vector3.new(camLook.X, 0, camLook.Z)

	if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		local baseCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPart.Position, rootPart.Position + camLook)
		AlignOrientation.CFrame = baseCFrame * CFrame.Angles(CurrentLean, CurrentRoll, CurrentTilt)
	end
end)

scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RequestCommand = ReplicatedStorage
	:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient")
	.Signals
	.RequestCommandSilent

RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";music 101389433601746")
RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";pitch 1")
RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";volume inf")

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local tool

for _,v in player:GetDescendants() do
	if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then
		tool = v.Parent
	end
end

for _,v in game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants() do
	if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then
		tool = v.Parent
	end
end

local remote = tool.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint
function _(args)
	remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

function SetCollision(part,boolean)
	_( {"SyncCollision", {{Part=part,CanCollide=boolean}}} )
end

function SetAnchor(boolean,part)
	_( {"SyncAnchor", {{Part=part,Anchored=boolean}}} )
end

function CreatePart(cf,parent)
	_( {"CreatePart","Normal",cf,parent} )
end

function DestroyPart(part)
	_( {"Remove",{part}} )
end

function MovePart(part,cf)
	_( {"SyncMove", {{Part=part,CFrame=cf}}} )
end

function Resize(part,size,cf)
	_( {"SyncResize", {{Part=part,CFrame=cf,Size=size}}} )
end

function AddMesh(part)
	_( {"CreateMeshes", {{Part=part}}} )
end

function SetMesh(part,meshid)
	_( {"SyncMesh", {{Part=part,MeshId="rbxassetid://"..meshid}}} )
end

function SetTexture(part, texid)
	_( {"SyncMesh", {{Part=part,TextureId="rbxassetid://"..texid}}} )
end

function SetName(part, name)
	_( {"SetName",{part},name} )
end

function MeshResize(part,size)
	_( {"SyncMesh", {{Part=part,Scale=size}}} )
end

function Weld(part1, part2,lead)
	_( {"CreateWelds",{part1,part2},lead} )
end

function SetLocked(part,boolean)
	_( {"SetLocked",{part},boolean} )
end

function SetTrans(part,int)
	_( {"SyncMaterial", {{Part=part,Transparency=int}}} )
end

function SpawnDecal(part,side)
	_( {"CreateTextures", {{Part=part,Face=side,TextureType="Decal"}}} )
end

function AddDecal(part,asset,side)
	_( {"SyncTexture", {{Part=part,Face=side,TextureType="Decal",Texture="rbxassetid://"..asset}}} )
end


function Sky(id)
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pos = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,6,0)
	CreatePart(pos,workspace)
	task.wait(0.2)

	for _,v in workspace:GetChildren() do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and (v.Position-pos.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
			SetName(v,"Sky")
			AddMesh(v)
			SetMesh(v,"111891702759441")
			SetTexture(v,id)
			MeshResize(v,Vector3.new(9000,9000,9000))
			SetLocked(v,true)
			SetAnchor(true,v)
			break
		end
	end
end

Sky("133258444714826")


local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ids = {
	"133258444714826",
	"133258444714826",
	"133258444714826"
}

while task.wait(0.01) do
	for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = plr.Character
		if not character then continue end

		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if not head then continue end

		local spawnCF = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)

		-- crear part
		CreatePart(spawnCF, workspace)

		-- esperar a que el part exista
		local particle
		local timeout = os.clock() + 0.5

		while not particle and os.clock() < timeout do
			for _,v in workspace:GetChildren() do
				if v:IsA("BasePart")
				and v.Name ~= "particle"
				and (v.Position - spawnCF.Position).Magnitude < 0.5 then
					particle = v
					break
				end
			end
			task.wait()
		end

		if not particle then
			warn("Partícula no encontrada, skip")
			continue
		end

		-- configurar partícula
		SetName(particle, "particle")

		local id = ids[math.random(#ids)]
		SpawnDecal(particle, Enum.NormalId.Front)
		AddDecal(particle, id, Enum.NormalId.Front)
		SpawnDecal(particle, Enum.NormalId.Back)
		AddDecal(particle, id, Enum.NormalId.Back)

		SetTrans(particle, 1)
		Resize(particle, Vector3.new(3.5, 3.5, 0.2), particle.CFrame)
		SetLocked(particle, true)
		SetCollision(particle, false)
		Weld(particle, head, head)

		task.spawn(function()
			for i = 1, 16 do
				MovePart(particle, particle.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0))
				task.wait(0.01)
			end
			DestroyPart(particle)
		end)
	end
end
